## Background

Apply the current head of #6568 (`813c0341f9411f85a074031fb79279ad04e2fcaa`) onto main, as requested.

## What changed

Add `.github/autobot/review-config.yml` unchanged from the source PR: enable comment reviews when a PR becomes ready for review.

## Details

Only the review-policy file changes. No model, training, dependency, or workflow code changes. This PR is not intended to be merged by Autobot.

## Tested

- Exact source-policy byte equivalence and `git diff --check`: passed.
- YAML policy-value checks: passed.
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: applicable hooks passed, no unstaged drift. Runtime used Python 3.13 instead of the requested 3.12; not full CI equivalence.
- External CI-Events parser tests unavailable through this session's access policy.
- Exact-head repository CI: pending.

detail.title: ci(autobot): AUT-2600 enable comment reviews on ready transitions

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+# .github/autobot/review-config.yml
+auto-review:
+  enabled: true
+  mode: comment
+  on: status_change
+  when: ready_for_review
